💡 pdf-document-layout-analysis | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide a programmatic and interactive service for analyzing, understanding, and converting the content and structure of PDF documents.
✨ Key Features: • Docker-powered microservice • PDF layout analysis (segmentation & classification) • OCR processing • Content extraction (text, titles, pictures, tables, formulas) • Reading order determination
📖 Summary: This repository offers a Docker-powered microservice for advanced PDF document layout analysis, OCR, and content extraction. It segments and classifies elements like text, titles, and images, determines reading order, and supports conversion to formats like Markdown and HTML with translation.
